import os
import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
LOG_DIR = Path(os.environ.get('CI_LOG_DIR', '/var/ci/logs'))

@dataclass
class ArchiveResult:
    build_id: str
    s3_uri: str
    size_bytes: int

def _record_archive(build_id: str, s3_uri: str, size: int) -> None:
    # Append an entry to a local archive index so archived builds can be looked up later
    index_path = LOG_DIR / 'archive_index.json'
    index = json.loads(index_path.read_text()) if index_path.exists() else {}
    index[build_id] = {'s3_uri': s3_uri, 'size_bytes': size, 'archived_at': time.time()}
    index_path.write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2))

def archive_build_logs_to_s3(build_id: str, bucket: str) -> ArchiveResult:
    path = LOG_DIR / f'{build_id}.log'
    size = path.stat().st_size
    key = f'build-logs/{build_id}.log'
    s3.upload_file(str(path), bucket, key)
    path.unlink()
    _record_archive(build_id, f's3://{bucket}/{key}', size)
    return ArchiveResult(build_id, f's3://{bucket}/{key}', size)
